accuracyChecks.method: Three rounds of 5 random generated items per chapter (10 chapters) plus 5 mock items, re-answered independently against the fact/grammar tables, the original passages and well-known facts about each lesson; tables checked for ambiguous options
fixes: 4-part grammar sets could ask a word and its own answer in two parts (संधि/समास) - parts now exclude each other
tatsam 'कर्म' now accepts both tadbhav forms 'काम / करम'
gender agreement in dialogue stems ('कर रही हैं' for two girls) and in situation options (करता/करती)
ambiguous alankar examples removed (lines with both anupras and punarukti or an upama); verb-type MCQ distractors changed to avoid causative verbs
antonym pairs with two valid answers removed (स्वदेश, मान, उत्थान); Kabir doha themes split so no distractor is also correct
writing topics, claims and grammar targets now cycle so practice forms do not repeat a topic; paragraph hints kept in order
accuracyChecks.note: All passages, poems and writing prompts are original; Kabir's dohe are public domain. Text questions use only safe facts (author, genre, theme, well-known plot points); 'मत बाँधो' questions avoid the poet's name and any line of the poem.
